source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each player secretly writes down: which **TRANSPORTS** their units will be embarked within at the start of the battle; which units will begin in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**; which **bodyguard** units, if any, their **leader** units will begin attached to (this is optional); and the one enhancement, of the two open to them, they will use. Then the players reveal these choices. At most half the units in a player's Combat Patrol can begin in strategic reserves, and units a Combat Patrol says must go into strategic reserves still count toward that limit. The Combat Patrol names the WARLORD model of each player, and that model has the **WARLORD** keyword.
